notes:
The spell-checking engine moves from Hunspell 1.7.1 (2022) to 1.7.5, picking up three upstream releases of crash and correctness fixes. You should see fewer odd results on unusual words, and the checker is harder to crash on malformed input.

- Undo after an automatic replacement now gives you back exactly what you typed. Typing two hyphens still becomes an em dash — but pressing undo once leaves “--” in place, instead of swallowing a hyphen along with it. Press undo again to remove them.
- Updated the editor and networking libraries Corylus is built on, closing a set of reported security issues — including one in how pasted content is handled, and several in the secure connections used for updates and dictionary downloads.
